scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @field-service/api build && pnpm --filter @field-service/admin build
scripts.dev:api: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @field-service/api build && pnpm --filter @field-service/api dev
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @field-service/api build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.mobile:export: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @field-service/mobile exec expo export --platform android --platform ios
